modelOverview: Introduced in 2016, the ref. 5230 modernised Patek Philippe's iconic World Time complication with a 38.5mm case, a black centre with hand-guilloched basket-weave decoration, and the ultra-thin self-winding Calibre 240 HU micro-rotor movement. The 5230G-010 is a 300-piece limited edition made for the 2017 Art of Watches Grand Exhibition in New York, distinguished from the standard-production 5230G by its dark blue dial engraved with the Manhattan skyline and a caseback crystal inscribed 'Patek Philippe New York 2017'.

5230G-010.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre 240 HU · 33 jewels · 21,600 vph (3Hz) · ~48h power reserve
5230G-010.materials: 18k white gold case on a blue alligator leather strap with an 18k white gold fold-over clasp
5230G-010.dial: Hand-engraved dark blue centre dial depicting the Manhattan skyline in relief, gold-applied hour markers, outer 24-city world time ring with day/night indicator, exhibition caseback engraved 'Patek Philippe New York 2017'
5230G-010.description: The 5230G-010 is a 300-piece limited edition of Patek Philippe's World Time reference 5230, produced to mark the 2017 Art of Watches Grand Exhibition in New York. Its dark blue dial is hand-engraved with a relief of the Manhattan skyline and paired with the ultra-thin, micro-rotor Calibre 240 HU, which drives the 24-city world time display and day/night indicator through the crown's simple city-name correction system. Every piece we offer is professionally sourced and authenticated.

variants.White Gold: The 18k white gold 5230G-010, cased at 38.5mm with the New York skyline blue dial and blue alligator strap, as issued for the 2017 Grand Exhibition limited edition of 300.
